item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 37 #NLPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 37 FINAL #NLPRSD
Weather System: Northeast Monsoon (Amihan)
Issued at 05:00 AM 02 November 2026

All Rainfall Advisories over forecast areas are now terminated.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are still advised to MONITOR the weather condition.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards. Residents along mountain slope are advised for possible landslides, mudslides, rockslides and flash flood.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 36 #NLPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 36 #NLPRSD
Weather System: Northeast Monsoon (Amihan) / Shearline
Issued at 02:00 PM 01 November 2026

Light to Moderate to at times Heavy rains are expected over #NuevaVizcaya(AlfonsoCastaneda, Kasibu, SantaFe, Aritao), #Quirino(Aglipay, Saguday), #Isabela(Echague, SanMariano, SanGuillermo), #Aurora(Dilasag, SanLuis, MariaAurora, Casiguran, Dinalungan, Dipaculao, Baler), #Benguet(Tuba, BaguioCity, Itogon, Bakun, Mankayan, Kibungan, Kapangan, Tublay, Sablan, LaTrinidad, Atok), #LaUnion(Pugo, Rosario, Tubao, Agoo, SantoTomas, Santol, SanGabriel, Bagulin, Burgos, Aringay, Sudipen), #Pangasinan(Agno, CityOfAlaminos, Alcala, Anda, Asingan, Balungao, Bani, Basista, Bautista, Binalonan, Binmaley, Bolinao, Burgos, DagupanCity, Dasol, Infanta, Labrador, Lingayen, Mabini, Malasiqui, Manaoag, Natividad, Pozorrubio, Rosales, SanCarlosCity, SanFabian, SanManuel, SanNicolas, SanQuintin, SantaMaria, SantoTomas, Sual, Tayug, Umingan, CityOfUrdaneta, Villasis, Laoac, Calasiao), #Abra(Malibcong, Tineg, Lacub, LicuanBaay, Bucloc, Daguioman, Boliney, Tubo, Sallapadan, Luba), #IlocosSur(Sigay, Suyo, Cervantes, Alilem, Quirino, Sugpon, SanEmilio, GregorioDelPilar), #MountainProvince(Tadian and Besao) within the next 2 to 3 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Quirino(Maddela, Nagtipunan), #Isabela(SanAgustin, Jones, Dinapigue, Palanan), #NuevaVizcaya(DupaxDelSur, DupaxDelNorte), #Aurora(Dingalan), #Pangasinan(Aguilar, Bayambang, Bugallon, Mangaldan, Mapandan, SantaBarbara, Sison, Urbiztondo, Mangatarem and SanJacinto) which may persist within 2 to 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 05:00 PM Today.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards. Residents along mountain slope are advised for possible landslides, mudslides, rockslides and flash flood.

Keep monitoring for updates.
